Markets.title: AU Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 53% to Rs 858 crore
Markets.summary: AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% increase in second-quarter net profit to Rs 858 crore. This growth was driven by a lower gross non-performing assets ratio of 1.99% and reduced provisions.

Markets.summary: The Trade Desk has emerged as the biggest loser on this list, with shares plunging 65.75% in 2026, from $37.96 at the en...

Markets.title: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 10 stocks rally up to 100% in FY27 so far
Markets.summary: The Government of Singapore's India portfolio includes about 14 stocks that have generated positive returns so far in FY27, with 10 rallying up to 100%. Conversely, nearly half of the stocks in the portfolio have posted negative returns during the same period.

Markets.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 results: Consolidated PAT rises 26% YoY to Rs 5,645 crore;  NII up 16%
Markets.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 26% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax to Rs 5,645 crore for the second quarter. During the same period, its net interest income rose 16% to reach Rs 8,459 crore.

Markets.title: FIIs dump Indian stocks for 10th straight week as markets slide: Is the worst over or more pain ahead?
Markets.summary: Foreign institutional investors dumped Indian stocks for the tenth consecutive week as the Nifty 50 declined 2.4% to close at 22,600. Selling pressure intensified across the market, causing the broader Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100 to plunge 5.6% and 7.3%, respectively.

Markets.title: Bitcoin hovers near $80,000 and Ethereum at $2,370 as macro uncertainty and weak institutional flows weigh on crypto markets
Markets.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $80,685 and Ethereum hovered near $2,370 alongside declines in major altcoins like XRP and Dogecoin. The drop was driven by macro uncertainty, weak institutional interest, and substantial outflows from Bitcoin and Ether ETFs.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine's Starlink satellite internet connection has returned to normal after a week of network limits. The previous slowdowns had negatively impacted the country's military and drone operations.

Geo-Political.title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
Geo-Political.summary: An arrest has been made following a fire at Adolf Hitler's former Eagle's Nest mountaintop retreat in Germany. Approximately 200 emergency personnel were deployed to fight the blaze at the historic Nazi dictator's Alpine residence.

Geo-Political.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
Geo-Political.summary: Kaylub Giamanco killed a teenage gunman who had murdered three children and a teacher at an Oregon school. Giamanco, praised as a hero for stopping the attack, expressed deep anguish over the children he was unable to save.

Geo-Political.title: British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas
Geo-Political.summary: A British woman died in the Bahamas after attempting to rescue her sons who had been swept away at sea. Police confirmed that the children were subsequently rescued from the water.

Geo-Political.title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election
Geo-Political.summary: A student-led movement has emerged as the strongest political challenge to Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić after nearly two years of anti-corruption protests. The resulting election has become a neck-and-neck race, pushing Vučić's ruling party to the limit.

Geo-Political.title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
Geo-Political.summary: A 65-year-old woman in Kenya has died from Ebola, becoming the country's second fatality from the virus. She was a close relative of the first victim, a man who recently traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress course. This unexpected visibility occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This article outlines ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transformed from a file-sharing platform into a generative AI tool for content creation. The platform allows users to generate, share, and monetize their AI-created content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries in 2023. These tools automate repetitive tasks to improve workflows, increase productivity, and handle natural language applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: AI content generators help users efficiently create engaging and relevant material for their audiences. With numerous options currently available on the market, choosing the right AI writing tool can be challenging.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner guide explains how the CJ Affiliate network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: 500 GW by 2030: Experts explain why India needs to power up battery storage capacity and grid infra to meet the target
Data & Insights.summary: India needs to expand battery storage and modernise its power grid to meet its goal of 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030. The country had already installed 300.50 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity as of July 31, 2026.

Data & Insights.title: India’s commerce and industry ministry working to identify AI proof sectors: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced that the government is working to identify economic sectors capable of withstanding artificial intelligence disruptions. This initiative aims to protect vulnerable industries and secure India's economic future against rapid technological changes.

Data & Insights.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
Data & Insights.summary: India is manufacturing domestic tunnel boring machines to support the construction of the 125-kilometer Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line. This project involves building 16 tunnels to advance connectivity in the Himalayas using homegrown technology.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector activity hits four-month high as inflation cools: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to faster manufacturing and services growth, rising new orders, and lower inflation. However, employment growth slowed to its weakest pace of the year during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: Taxing top 1% isn't enough to solve income inequality; how governments spend matters | Opinion
Data & Insights.summary: Simply taxing the top one percent of earners is insufficient to resolve income inequality. Governments must also focus on how they spend public funds to create truly just social institutions.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September as supply constraints from the Iran conflict eased. Refiners purchased additional spot cargoes after Middle Eastern producers and traders increased shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

India.title: "Sedition": BJP Slams Farooq Abdullah For Remarks On Kashmiris, Pakistan
India.summary: The BJP accused National Conference leader Farooq Abdullah of sedition for stating that Pakistan's diplomatic efforts are helping Kashmiris make their voices heard globally. Abdullah had also claimed that the Indian government's intentions toward the people of Kashmir are not right.

India.title: Jamia Millia Islamia Closes 2 Libraries On Campus Amid Protests, Cites Security Concerns
India.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia has closed two campus libraries indefinitely starting October 24. The university cited security concerns resulting from ongoing student protests as the reason for the closure.

India.title: In Tiger Shroff Assassination Bid, Mumbai Police Detain 11th Suspect From Indore
India.summary: Mumbai police detained an eleventh suspect from Indore in connection with an alleged assassination plot against actor Tiger Shroff. Authorities announced that all arrested individuals will face charges under the stringent Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act.

India.title: Jamia Millia Islamia Students, Guards Clash During Protest, Classes Moved Online
India.summary: Students and guards at Jamia Millia Islamia clashed during a protest demanding the restoration of the student union, which was disbanded in 2006. Consequently, the university has moved all classes online following the campus unrest.

India.title: NDTV And VFS Global Announce 100 Media And Communications Scholarships Over 10 Years
India.summary: NDTV and VFS Global have launched a 10-year program offering 100 media and communications scholarships to young Indian talent. The initiative provides selected students with international exposure and internship opportunities.

India.title: Man Shot Dead By Friends After Argument Over Scooter Parking In Amritsar
India.summary: Amit was shot dead by his friends in Amritsar following an argument over scooter parking. His family members rushed outside after hearing the gunshot and found him lying in a pool of blood.

General.title: Met Police says letter with claims about Meghan's father not shared with other law enforcement
General.summary: The Metropolitan Police stated they passed information regarding Meghan Markle's father to the duchess. They confirmed this information was not shared with any other law enforcement agencies.

General.title: Plan for Northern Olympics to get £7m in Healey's Budget
General.summary: Chancellor Healey's Budget will provide £7 million to fund a full feasibility study for hosting the Olympic Games in northern England. The study will examine in detail how hosting the event in the region could work.

General.title: Between quick wins and big dreams lies Burnham's biggest test
General.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer has set long-term goals for the UK up to the year 2040. However, political commentator Laura Kuenssberg argues he must first survive and navigate many difficult years ahead.

General.title: Mum dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in Bahamas
General.summary: A mother in the Bahamas died after entering the ocean to rescue her two sons who had been swept away by the current. Police confirmed that both children were subsequently pulled safely from the water.

General.title: Infantino tells BBC Sport he is backed by 'vast majority' of world football
General.summary: Fifa president Gianni Infantino stated that he has the backing of the vast majority of world football. He also dismissed questions regarding whether he considered resigning over the World Cup ticketing controversy.

General.title: Strictly's new presenters - after mixed reviews have they found their feet?
General.summary: New *Strictly* presenters Josh Widdicombe, Emma Willis, and Johannes Radebe initially received mixed reviews from critics. However, reviewers now report that the hosts are settling into their roles and improving their performance.
